releaseNotes: Agent workspace with retained native Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex sessions, including named conversation resume.
Dock Agent or the independent Review session below file review; resize or unpin without restarting the session.
Slim dock toolbar with separated compact controls and actual 11px terminal text; undocking restores normal sizing.
Direct notes and selection insertion without Enter, plus repository file-and-line navigation from terminal output.
Track individual prompts with working-tree checkpoints, change summaries and exact per-prompt review diffs.
Dedicated scoped review requests, custom instructions and follow-ups, with immediate review-brief collapse while sending.
Search branches inside comparison selectors; improved startup geometry, Windows PTY metadata and retained scroll anchors.
Available through the normal update manifest and installers; isolated preview profiles intentionally keep updates disabled.
